title: Architectural and Regularization Components in Deep Learning Medical Image Registration: Systematic Ablation Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.05484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning registration methods routinely stack two kinds of enhancement on a base network: architectural additions such as affine pre-alignment stages, and training-objective additions such as regularization losses. Papers tend to adopt both at once, so it is unclear which is doing the work. I ran a controlled ablation to separate them. Using the OASIS brain MRI dataset (394 training subjects, 20 test subjects), I trained four variants of the same registration pipeline: a baseline 3D U-Net with basic similarity losses, the same U-Net with a full regularization suite, an affine-plus-deformable architecture with basic losses, and the affine architecture with the full suite. I evaluated registration accuracy (MSE, NCC, SSIM), deformation quality (Jacobian determinant preservation, displacement statistics, an anatomical plausibility score), and computational cost. translated_title: 深度学习医学图像配准中的架构组件与正则化组件：系统性消融研究
translated_abstract: 深度学习配准方法通常在基础网络上叠加两类增强手段：架构层面的附加组件（如仿射预对齐阶段）和训练目标层面的附加组件（如正则化损失）。由于论文往往同时采用两者，因此不清楚究竟是哪一类在发挥作用。本研究进行了受控消融实验将二者区分开来。使用OASIS脑部MRI数据集（394个训练受试者、20个测试受试者），作者训练了同一配准流程的四个变体：采用基础相似性损失的基线3D U-Net、采用完整正则化套件的相同U-Net、采用基础损失的仿射加可变形架构，以及采用完整套件的仿射架构。研究评估了配准精度（MSE、NCC、SSIM）、形变质量（雅可比行列式保持度、位移统计量、解剖学合理性评分）以及计算成本。结果表明，仅正则化一项就贡献了大部分性能增益，相对提升了21.3%……
tldr: 本文通过系统性消融实验发现，在深度学习医学图像配准中，正则化损失对性能提升的贡献远大于仿射预对齐等架构增强组件，仅正则化即可带来21.3%的相对增益。
